description: Intended Lines - Roads is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Tasmania Government's The List Data. Intended Lines are a planning instrument to depict future planned road corridors for State roads, both intended new line of a State highway or subsidiary, or intended line of a new State highway or subsidiary. Section 9A of the Roads & Jetties Act 1935 contains provisions to proclaim Intended Lines. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Tasmania Government's The List Data. Its tags are Australia. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
